stories.h: Medicaid, SNAP work rules loom for Snohomish County residents
stories.s: At a Lynnwood briefing, the state said at least 200,000 Washingtonians could lose Apple Health coverage by the end of 2027. Work requirements start Jan. 1, and SNAP exemptions are narrowing.

stories.h: Repeat boat-theft suspect released again; Everett boaters warned
stories.s: A man arrested three times in 12 days in October over stolen boats and crab pots was released Nov. 4. Police and WDFW urge owners to check stored boats and record serial numbers.

stories.h: Everett stash-house drug courier sentenced to five years
stories.s: Sylvestre Ramos tended an Everett stash house where officers found more than 8 kg of fentanyl. He got five years in federal prison; the wider investigation seized about 34 kg of fentanyl.

coming.h: WSU men's basketball plays Hawaii in Everett
coming.s: Washington State faces Hawaii at 7 p.m. at Angel of the Winds Arena.
